quarterly_data.quarter: Micron press release: Micron Unveils Micron Research Labs, a U.S.-Based (08-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Micron unveiled Micron Research Labs, a long-horizon research institution headquartered in Boise backed by a planned $10 billion investment over the next decade, covering memory technologies, advanced memory and compute architectures, packaging and future semiconductor manufacturing. Micron anticipates breaking ground in calendar 2027 on a Micron Research Labs facility capable of hosting hundreds of researchers. CEO Sanjay Mehrotra: this builds on the more than $250 billion separately committed to manufacturing and R&D across the United States.
quarterly_data.figure: $10 billion planned over the next decade; facility groundbreaking in calendar 2027
